svg.title: LLM Music Lens
svg.desc: Pixel-art banner: a playhead runs over a waveform, beat marks and a piano roll at 120 BPM, lighting each beat and note and showing the chords C, Am, F and G; the screen then reports BPM 120 and the key C major, and the report flies to Claude, who nods along in headphones next to a speaker.
